top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a quantitative flat-band prediction at a specific magic twist angle (Bistritzer-MacDonald 2011) that a falsifiable experiment confirmed (Jarillo-Herrero group, 2018), with the correlated-insulator and superconducting phases reproduced by many groups and a citation that makes no claim about the pairing mechanism. It opened a platform that changed what condensed-matter physicists work on. I accept that its credit is incomplete (Cao, Dean, earlier twisted-bilayer band-structure theory) and that it is younger, so P001 is a close and defensible second: a mature, distinct, tightly credited invention (magic-wavelength lattice clocks, Katori and Ye) that I would not obstruct. Either award is clearly preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; field proximity to P002 (electronic-structure theory of 2D materials) is not a documented tie to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer, and no documented tie to Katori or Ye
